jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Fullstack
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Software Engineer Fullstack

Job Location: Poland-Poznan

Sound made by Sennheiser – For more than 80 years, we are among the world’s leading manufacturers of audio products, building the future of audio. We are proud of our finely engineered microphones and audio solutions that connect people and create remarkable sound experiences - whether in the studio, conference room, or on stage.

For us, the audio industry is one of the most exciting to work in. In our global family business, you can expect not only a unique team where we trust, value and support each other, but also the opportunity to make your own significant contribution to our collective progress.

Sounds good? Join us!

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Development & Architecture — Leads the development of responsive, intuitive interfaces using React, Angular, or Vue.js for web, and/or Flutter for cross-platform mobile, integrating frontend components cleanly into the broader stack and setting technical direction and best practices for the team.
Backend & Cloud Development — Builds and maintains cloud-native backend services on Azure (Functions, App Services, Cosmos DB,AKS), leverages Azure Blob Storage, Media Services, and Event Hubs for audio file processing, and develops RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and WebSocket services for low-latency frontend-backend communication.
Data & Performance — Designs and optimizes large-scale audio data storage using Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and other NoSQL solutions, and owns performance, scalability, and security across the stack, with particular attention to real-time processing and low-latency operations.
Leadership & Collaboration — Mentors junior and mid-level developers, leads technical reviews, and coordinates with product, design, engineering, and audio teams to deliver high-quality features, taking on broader technical responsibility and contributing to resourcing and planning decisions.
Engineering Practices — Maintains and optimizes CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, defines unit, integration, and end-to-end testing strategies, and champions security best practices to ensure compliance in managing audio content.

Required Qualifications

5–8 years of experience in fullstack development, including substantial frontend ownership, working on cloud-native applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, with demonstrated

depth in at least one.

Strong knowledge of Flutter/Dart for cross-platform mobile app development.
Proficiency in backend development using languages such as C#, Python, Node.js, or Go.
Expertise in designing and consuming RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud Services, including Azure Functions, App Services, Cosmos DB, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases, with practical experience using Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, or similar.
Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native development practices, particularly with Azure DevOps.
Experience with cloud security practices, including Azure AD, OAuth2, JWT, and Azure Key Vault.
Demonstrated ability to analyze and synthesize complex technical problems and solve them independently, adapting approach across both well-defined tasks and ambiguous, evolving requirements.
Proven track record of mentoring, coordinating, or leading the work of other engineers.
Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences and to influence decisions across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with audio-related technologies, such as the Web Audio API, audio streaming protocols, or media content handling.
Familiarity with real-time audio processing and on-demand media delivery.
Experience with Azure Media Services for audio/video processing and streaming.
Knowledge of serverless architectures and event-driven design using Azure Event Grid, Service Bus, or Logic Apps.
Experience working in agile development environments, with familiarity in Scrum or Kanban methodologies.
Passion for audio technology and a deep understanding of the challenges and needs within the audio industry.

What You Can Expect From Us

Inspiring Work Environment: Become a part of our international family business, where a modern and dynamic work atmosphere awaits you. At Sennheiser, people and their mindset are at the heart of everything we do - they are our most valuable asset.
Flexible Working Models: We offer flexible working hours and mobile work options to help you balance your professional and personal life.
International Collaboration: Look forward to working in a global team collaboration and contributing to exciting projects that shape the future of audio.

The audio world is diverse — from concerts and lecture halls to streaming platforms, meeting spaces, and studio recordings. So are we at Sennheiser. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, disability, or age.

Do you want to join the team? Apply now.

Please only use our online application form for applications.

Do you have any questions?

Please feel free to contact us at jobs@sennheiser.com.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Software Developer
jobs.description:
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably.

We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies.

If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at AVEVA Careers.

For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our
Privacy Policy
.

Job Title: Principal Cloud Software Developer

Location: Sundsvall, Sweden (Hybrid, 50% working time at the office)

Employment Type: Full time

The job

Join our Sundsvall team to design and develop innovative industrial software solutions. You'll work on challenging problems in data management and cloud-based systems that help our customers in industrial automation and engineering. All our cloud products are hosted in Kubernetes, and everything we build — whether cloud or on-premises — is designed for containerized applications.

We're looking for developers who are curious, collaborative, and eager to grow. Whether you're more experienced or earlier in your career, if you're passionate about solving complex problems and working with modern technologies, we'd love to hear from you. There's also the opportunity to work as a fullstack developer if that's where your interests lie.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and debug software applications in C#/.NET
Collaborate with product owners, architects, and teams across our global organization
Participate in code reviews and help maintain high quality standards
Work in an agile environment with continuous integration and deployment
Contribute to both new features and maintaining existing codebases
Grow your technical skills and share knowledge with the team

Essential Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Extensive software development experience in C# and .NET
Record of achievements using modern development practices including AI
Ability to write clean, well-structured code
Good communication skills and enjoy working collaboratively

Desired Skills And Competencies

Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)
AI-accelerated software development methodologies
Knowledge of RESTful APIs
Familiarity with communication protocols and technologies such as MQTT, OPC-UA, Modbus, Kafka, WebSockets or RabbitMQ
Familiarity with agile methodologies
Interest in engineering or industrial automation
Experience with TypeScript or other programming languages

R&D at AVEVA

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.

Come and join AVEVA to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

jobs.title: Hubspot Software Engineer Co-op Placement Program (Ireland)
jobs.description:
About This Role

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As a Software Engineering Spring Co-op, you’ll help solve complex problems and build real products that thousands of customers depend on. You’ll work alongside HubSpot engineers in small, collaborative teams, with the opportunity to take ownership of the software you create and start shipping production code early in your co-op.

We know there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. Whatever your background or identity, we encourage you to apply if this role excites you and gives you an opportunity to grow.

We have the following roles open for our 2027 program in EMEA :

Spring Co-ops - Must be available to work full time for the duration of their required co-op placement (Start date: January - May 2027)

What You’ll Do

Build and ship production software alongside experienced HubSpot engineers.
Solve complex engineering problems that have an impact on HubSpot customers.
Contribute to back-end, front-end, or data and systems infrastructure projects based on your team.
Collaborate with engineers and teammates to design, develop, test, and improve software.
Take ownership of meaningful projects and contribute ideas from development through delivery.
Learn new technologies and engineering practices while applying them to real-world challenges.
Communicate and collaborate with your team as you work through technical decisions and challenges.

Technology You Might Use

Our stack is diverse — you'll be placed based on your interests and skills:

Back end

Java 11, REST APIs, Dropwizard, Kafka, MySQL, Spark, AWS

Data & systems infrastructure

Kubernetes, Redis, ElasticSearch, Hadoop, HBase, ZooKeeper

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

Web development experience through coursework, independent projects, work experience, or equivalent hands-on experience.
Curiosity and motivation to learn new technologies and grow your engineering skills.
Clear communication and collaboration skills.
Confidence taking ownership of projects and contributing in a fast-paced environment.
Interest in understanding HubSpot’s business, products, and culture.
Availability to work full-time, 40 hours per week, for the full duration of the Spring 2027 co-op.
Ability to work from an eligible location within the United Kingdom.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience building projects beyond coursework, such as mobile apps, web applications, games, or other software.
Experience with one or more of the technologies listed above.
Experience taking ownership of a technical project or initiative.

Where You’ll Work

Location: Ireland
Work type: Remote, hybrid, or onsite, based on eligible HubSpot work options.
Schedule: This is a full-time, Spring Co-op with a start date anywhere from January to May for a minimum duration of 4 months long.
Travel: Travel is not required. Depending on timing and business needs, you may have the opportunity to visit a HubSpot office for a Product Summit or team travel.

We encourage candidates to apply for only one role per hiring cycle. Candidates who previously interviewed for this role should wait until the next hiring season before reapplying.

Application Requirements

Resumes/CVs must be submitted in English.
Cover letter: Not required.
Please use your preferred and most active email address when applying. Avoid using a school or university email address if it may become inactive soon.

Apply for one role per hiring cycle only.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range

€40.040—€40.040 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.
